hooks.on_prompt: takoctl status set working --text "Thinking..." && takoctl progress indeterminate
hooks.on_approval: takoctl status set needs_approval --text "Approval requested" && takoctl notify "Antigravity requested tool approval" --title "Approval Required" && takoctl progress pause
hooks.on_wait_input: takoctl status set waiting_for_input --text "Waiting for input" && takoctl notify "Antigravity waiting for input" --title "Input Needed" && takoctl progress clear
hooks.on_done: takoctl status set done --text "Done" && takoctl notify "Antigravity completed task" --title "Task Complete" && takoctl progress clear
hooks.on_session_end: takoctl status clear && takoctl progress clear
